disclosed_priors: P1 (formed by the agent from stored WL54 numbers before any WL55 run): WL53's camera readout KC (p53_tracer) records next-event estimates at collisions only and excludes the unscattered (ballistic) term, justified as exp(-10) through 1 cm. For OBLIQUE views near an edge the line of sight crosses a thin medium wedge (e.g. obot through the top 1-3 mm of slab_lo's -y face) and sees another bright surface (slab_hi's bottom) through it. A rough estimate from amend3_vol.json signals (transmission ~0.3 over a 2 mm band, seen radiance 3.7x / 3.5x / 1.6x the group's mean in R / G / B) predicts a missing ~23 / 22 / 10 %, close to the observed -22.1 / -20.0 / -10.7 %. This is a HYPOTHESIS to be tested by rule B-E, not a result.

P2: WL54's matched-resolution K control (c54_kfine) used Dout = Din = 16 (4x4 / 4x4) at both resolutions and C with 128 / 32 rays per out-cell, unlike WL53 production (8x8 out / 4x4 in, 128 rays per out-cell at 64 out-bins). WL55's matched arms use 8x8 / 4x4 at every resolution.

P3: before this commit only implementation smoke runs were made on LabServer69 (tests/test_k55.py, two debug passes: a COR source-weight bug (each pool refill normalised to the full source flux) was found and fixed, and two test tolerances were set to their declared values (ballistic MC sample count; leak rate per stage_D). No comparison against any reference or stored WL54 evidence was computed.

definitions.groups: port group = component : rest face (WL53 p53_report.port_groups); ruled iff >= 5 ports and >= 2 % of the camera's reference signal

units.declared: WL53: interior unit (centre + 4 corner rays at 0.1/0.9 hit the same port), >= 30 pixels per port
units.amended: WL54 A1: centre-ray unit, >= 30 pixels AND >= 90 % of the port's expected pixel count (projected area / pixel area)
units.primary: amended; the declared unit is always reported next to it

definitions.bias: B = sum_ports(pred - ref) / sum_ports(ref) per group and channel
definitions.SE: sqrt(SE_ref^2 + SE_oracle^2); SE_ref from Cycles seeds (std/sqrt(n) per port, summed in quadrature); SE_oracle = |B(seed 1) - B(seed 2)| / 2 where two oracle (K) seeds exist
definitions.rule_3pct: a ruled group/channel passes iff |B| <= 0.03 + 3 SE (WL53 historical composition contract, unchanged)
definitions.reference: Cycles 3.5.1 volume path tracing (WL53 validated scope), CPU, 1024 spp, 0.5 mm pixels unless stated, 2 seeds (WL55 renders 5501 / 5502; known-field 5511 / 5512; held-out 5521 / 5522; Stage E 5531 / 5532)

stage_B.purpose: attribute the residual medium-transport errors BEFORE choosing a representation

instruments.COR: continuous oracle (k55_cor.py): a multi-domain path tracer with TR's medium physics (same free flight, phase, albedo weighting, Russian roulette, float64 accumulators), exact positions / directions everywhere, air segments traced with the scene intersector, Lambert reflection, black absorbers, Lambertian emitters; NO ports and NO bins in the transport. Readout per port: medium = next-event radiance toward each camera direction (identical estimator to KC), Lambert = rho/pi E. It is the limit of the K/C composition for infinitely fine ports and bins. Diagnostic instrument, never the reference.
instruments.KB: ballistic (unscattered) camera-readout term. Composition: KB[i <- (j,b)] = projected-area average over port i of exp(-sigma_t s) / (A_j pi / Din) for the backward camera ray from port i that exits the medium through cell j with outward direction in bin b (interface-consistent: in-cell radiance uniform over cell and bin). COR: the same backward ray continued through air to the seen surface, whose radiance toward the camera is COR's own per-triangle readout (medium NEE, Lambert rho/pi E, emitter analytic). Readouts: nee (= WL53) and nee+KB.
instruments.OPS: sparse TR operators (k55_ops.py) on refined cell meshes of the WL53 ports (c54_casp.refine_mesh, welded): uniform levels s = 1 / 2 / 4 (10 / 5 / 2.5 mm) with 8x8 out / 4x4 in bins, 2048 photons per in-cell, T stored sparse (<= one entry per photon exit), KC accumulated on the coarse 1 cm output ports (the compared quantity; exact aggregation of NEE flux). Seeds: 1 cm 5541 / 5542, 5 mm 5551 / 5552, 2.5 mm 5561 / 5562 (slab rest); bend90 2.5 mm 5563 / 5564, dent 2.5 mm 5565 / 5566 (also used by Stage E); 1 cm Din 64 (8x8 in) 5543. Camera directions: top, bot, otop, obot, obotx = (-sin50, 0, -cos50).
instruments.matched_composition: K and C at the same cells: C = c54_casp.cast_adaptive with equal ray density (128 rays per out-cell at 1 cm, 32 at 5 mm, 8 at 2.5 mm, 64 out-bins), sun term = TR.run_sun on the cell mesh (16 M photons per medium domain, seeds 5591 + domain), Lambert floor at the same cell level; solve = p53_compose.solve unchanged; spectral radius = A^2 estimator (c54_casp.rho_robust); C seeds 5581 (replicate 5582 at 1 cm).
instruments.known_field_fixtures: gap4 / gap8 geometry; slab_lo = medium; slab_hi replaced by a black box. Fields: U = slab_hi bottom is a one-sided Lambertian emitter of radiance 1; X = radiance exp(-(x + 0.05)/0.005) (decay from the -x opening, ~7x per cm, the WL54 near-contact profile); S = no emitter, the gap8/gap4 sun (black slab_hi). Single flight by construction (exits are absorbed). Cycles cams gapdown, obot, obotx, bot (0.5 mm, 2 seeds). Arms: COR (exact field and transport) and K_s (s = 1, 2, 4) applied to the exactly cast binned field (64 M emitter rays) with nee and nee+KB readouts. For S: TR.run_sun exact sun term (= composition L0) and the binned-sun diagnostic.
instruments.outgoing_test: S fixtures: arrival flux on the black slab_hi bottom per 2.5 mm triangle pair and per 1 cm port from (i) COR (exact exits) vs (ii) TR.run_sun out-cells at level s emitted uniformly per (cell, out-bin) through C (equal ray density). Measures the outgoing spatial / directional aggregation B relative to the continuous field (same TR physics).
instruments.cycles_full: gap4, gap8 (cams gapdown, gapup, obot, obotx, bot, top, otop), floor, bend90 (cams top, otop, underup, underdown) at 0.5 mm, 2 seeds; WL53 1 mm renders are reported as the historical reference

stage_B.decomposition: per ruled group / channel / readout: T = B(arm vs Cycles); R = B(COR vs Cycles); I = B(arm vs COR) (interface)

rules.B-COR-valid: COR is usable iff (i) isolated slab iso_L2: COR vs TR.run_sun KC group bias <= 0.3 % on ruled groups; (ii) floor_lam (Lambert only): COR vs WL54 F16 <= 1 % on the ruled amended groups; (iii) COR vs Cycles on directly lit medium faces (top / -x of the full scenes) <= 1 %. If it fails, COR is not used for attribution and the failure is reported.
rules.B-E (readout): a group's error is readout-dominant iff adding KB reduces |T| by >= 50 % in >= 2 channels (applied to P10 and to COR vs Cycles). The gap8 obot slab_lo:-y group is the explicit target of P1.
rules.B-R (reference / physics / comparison): after the readout correction, |R| > max(1 %, 3 SE) and |R| >= 0.5 |T| -> the group's error is not the interface; reported with its comparison-unit (declared / amended) and pixel-size sensitivity
rules.B-I (interface): |I| >= max(1 %, 0.5 |T|): interface error. Sub-attribution: SPATIAL iff |I| decreases monotonically 10 -> 5 -> 2.5 mm and |I(2.5)| <= 0.5 |I(10)|; DIRECTIONAL iff |I(din64) - I(10)| >= |I(10)| / 3; ORACLE NOISE iff |I(s1) - I(s2)| >= |I| / 2; C NOISE iff |I(c1) - I(c2)| >= |I| / 2
rules.B-KF (K-side spatial loss, single flight: on the known fields U / X, the K_s vs COR group bias at s = 1 >= 1 % (|.| > 3 SE) and at s = 4 <= half of it -> incident spatial aggregation loss (A) demonstrated for that group; the outgoing test with pooled |error| >= 1 % or per-port p90 >= 5 % at s = 1 that halves at s = 4 -> outgoing aggregation loss (B) demonstrated
rules.gate_C: the K boundary-information limit is DEMONSTRATED iff (B-I SPATIAL on >= 1 ruled medium near-contact group in >= 2 channels, after the readout correction) AND (B-KF shows A or B loss). Otherwise Stage C is not entered and the actual limiting factor is reported.

stage_C.candidate: CAK - contact-adaptive co-refined K/C boundary cells (ONE mechanism, predeclared before Stage B evidence)

semantics.boundary_coordinates: cells are sub-squares of the WL53 rest ports (material coordinates), built exactly on the triangulated surface (c54_casp.refine_mesh, welded); levels l in {1, 2, 4} per port (10 / 5 / 2.5 mm)
semantics.level_rule: the CASP geometry-only rule on the CURRENT geometry of all components (256 cosine rays per coarse port, near if t < 4 h, nu_min 0.05, l = clamp(2^ceil(log2(c h / d)), 1, l_max), c = 2), l_max = 4. Applied to medium AND Lambert ports.
semantics.spatial_directional_basis: piecewise constant per cell; directions 8x8 out / 4x4 in (Shirley-Chiu + Malley, equal projected solid angle) in each triangle's frame (current normal + affine image of the rest tangent), unchanged
semantics.normalisation: flux per (cell, bin); in-cell radiance uniform over cell and bin (L = phi / (A pi / D))
semantics.K_on_cells: K_cells = R_out K_fine P_in, K_fine = TR oracle on the uniform 2.5 mm cell mesh of the domain (material coordinates); P_in distributes a cell's in-flux over its fine sub-cells by area (same in-bin); R_out sums fine out-cells (same out-bin); KC_cells = KC_fine P_in (coarse output ports). Equal in expectation to a TR run on the cells.
semantics.correspondence: source and receiver cells are the same objects for K and C (identity mapping)
semantics.C: c54_casp.cast_adaptive on the cell mesh, equal ray budget per coarse port (8192 = 128 x 64)
semantics.sun_term: TR.run_sun on the 2.5 mm mesh, out-cells summed to the cells (exact first order)
semantics.readout: L0 + (KC_cells [+ KB_cells if B-E adopts it]) phi_in_ind; Lambert rho/pi (E_ext + E_ind)
semantics.rigid: K_fine is reused (invariant in material coordinates, WL53); a rigid move that changes contacts re-levels the cells and re-aggregates K_cells, no new TR
semantics.non_rigid: K_fine is configuration dependent (stale vs current evaluated in Stage E); levels follow the current geometry
semantics.cost: K_fine storage and TR time are oracle costs; K_cells nnz <= nnz(K_fine); unknowns follow near-contact area

stage_C.falsifiers: CAK is falsified for its purpose if it fails to recover >= 50 % of the uniform-2.5 mm arm's error reduction on the ruled near-contact medium groups, or if it fails a Stage D operator test, or if its coupled errors on the held-out geometry exceed the uniform 1 cm arm's
stage_C.reference_arms: uniform 10 / 5 mm (mandatory matched pair) and 2.5 mm (declared finer diagnostic) - all with matched K/C
stage_C.amendment_condition: if Stage B shows that the dominant K-side loss is not spatial (e.g. directional) CAK is not built and the dependency is reported (no second candidate)

held_out.gap6s: two slabs, 6 mm gap, slab_hi translated by (3.7, -2.1) mm in x / y (port grids misaligned, no rotation so camera directions stay valid for KC), sun zenith 35 deg azimuth 25 deg; cams gapdown, gapup, obot, obotx, bot; Cycles 5521 / 5522 rendered only after the candidate and every rule are frozen; NOT used in Stage B or to design / select anything
held_out.floor_c4: Stage E near-contact geometry change: the floor scene's slab rigidly lowered to 4 mm clearance and shifted (2.3, 1.7) mm; under-cameras at z = 2 mm; Cycles 5531 / 5532 after freeze

operator_tests: energy closure at albedo 1 on a small 2 x 2 x 1 cm block at 2.5 mm: column sums == 1 (leaks <= 1e-5)
reciprocity: port-pair area-weighted asymmetry <= cross-seed noise x 1.2
boundary correspondence: cells nest in ports, area sums exact (1e-12)
flux preservation across resolutions: K_cells column sums == area-weighted K_fine column sums (1e-6)
rigid-frame consistency: K_fine of the small block at a rigid pose vs rest, ||dK|| / ||seed noise|| in [0.85, 1.15]
no K/C overlap: zero C back-face hits, K walk isolated (leaks + wrong side <= 1e-5)
stable repeated composition: rho (A^2) < 1 and converged
directional readout: KC + KB vs COR on directly lit faces <= 1 %
stage_D.coupled: arms P10, P10 + CASP (WL54 C1 equivalent: medium coarse), P05, P025, CAK on gap4, gap8, floor, bend90 (design) and gap6s (held-out); readout nee and nee+KB; both units
stage_D.verdict: RESTORED iff every ruled medium group / channel passes rule_3pct on design and held-out scenes; otherwise PARTIAL with counts per arm; operator correctness separately

conditions: rigid: floor -> floor_c4 (K_fine reused, cells re-levelled) and the small-block rigid test
metrics: ||K_cur - K_rest|| / ||seed noise|| at 2.5 mm, aggregated to CAK cells and to 1 cm port pairs
spatial support (energy within distance bins / dent support)
coupled radiance difference D = pred(stale) - pred(current) per group with K-seed SE
temporal change tracking rest -> deformed (per-port slope / corr)

rules.B_predict: predicted temporal change (current K) vs Cycles: per-port slope in [0.9, 1.1] and corr >= 0.9 on ruled groups
rules.C_rank: per group: |D| > 2 (|B_current| + 3 SE) AND |B_current| < |B_stale| by > 3 SE_D (WL54 rule extended); otherwise ranking NOT SUPPORTED with the limiting term (bias floor vs oracle variance) identified

measure: K application and C application time per iteration
re-levelling + re-aggregation time after a rigid contact change
scaling: near-contact density (gap 4 / 6 / 8 mm, floor 1 cm / 4 mm)
stage_F.tractability_rule: CONDITIONALLY SUPPORTED iff CAK recovers >= 80 % of the uniform-2.5 mm error reduction (vs P10) at <= 50 % of its unknowns on the design scenes; no inference-speed claim

resource_limits.gpu: 24 GB, one process at a time

a second architecture hypothesis would be needed
further compute cannot change the decision

amendments.A1.1_record: B-COR-valid: (i) iso slab 0.03 % (tests) and (ii) floor_lam pass; (iii) FAILS: COR vs Cycles on the lit OBLIQUE -x faces (obotx) +2.0..+2.6 % (slab_hi) / -0.7..-1.6 % (slab_lo), achromatic; lit top faces <= 0.1 %. Per the declared rule COR is NOT the primary attribution basis; it stays a labelled diagnostic.
amendments.A1.1_COR_free_gate: the gate is ALSO evaluated without COR: SPATIAL_T iff T(arm vs Cycles, nee+KB) decreases monotonically in |.| 10 -> 5 -> 2.5 mm and |T(P025)| <= 0.5 |T(P10)| (ruled face-on near-contact group, >= 2 channels); A-loss_T iff K_s vs Cycles on the U / X fields at s = 1 is >= 1 % (> 3 SE) and halves at s = 4 on a face-on group; B-loss: the outgoing test is oracle-internal (unchanged). Both versions are reported; the COR-free version is primary.
amendments.A1.2_pixel_diagnostic: oblique side-face groups carry a sub-mm ballistic band (1/e height ~0.64 mm at 50 deg) that 0.5 mm point-sampled pixels may alias. Renders (CUDA): gap8 and gap4 cams obot, obotx and kf_gap8_U / kf_gap4_U cams obot, obotx at 0.25 and 0.125 mm, seed 5541 (gap) / 5542 (kf). Rule: a group whose amended-unit reference signal changes by >= 3 % (any channel) between 0.5 and 0.125 mm is NOT pixel-converged at 0.5 mm; such groups are then compared against the 0.125 mm reference and labelled. Groups changing < 3 % keep the 0.5 mm reference and their residual R is reported as unexplained.
amendments.A1.3_readout: B-E holds for COR on the P1 target (gap8 obot slab_lo:-y: reduction 0.85 / 0.86 / 0.95). From Stage D on the primary readout is nee + KB (ballistic term at the arm's own interface); nee (WL53) is always reported. For P10 the interface-consistent KB overshoots (+12.6 %) and converges with refinement (I +7.7 -> +1.9 -> 0.0): the ballistic readout inherits the boundary resolution.
amendments.A1.4_stage_C: gate demonstrated (declared and COR-free) -> Stage C entered with the PREDECLARED CAK (no parameter changed). Held-out gap6s references, sun term, COR and all arms are run now. Stage D operator tests for CAK on a 2 x 2 x 1 cm block (albedo 1 closure, passivity, reciprocity vs cross-seed noise, rigid pose, flux across resolutions, zero / linearity) + the coupled fixtures.
amendments.A1.5_ops: dent 2.5 mm operators (dent_L4_s1 / s2, declared in OPS) were omitted from the first GPU chain by oversight; built now for Stage E, together with the Stage E scenes floor_c4 and dent (references 5531 / 5532, CUDA).
